note: Reference versions for the security patch-lag rule in scripts/build-data.mjs. Update by hand when a new stable ships; values come from this site's own research files.

chromium.label: Chrome 156 (156.0.8078.74, 2026-10-27)
chromium.note: Chrome moved to a two-week cycle from Chrome 153 (2026-09-08).

firefox.label: Firefox 159 (2026-10-27)
firefox.note: Two-week cycle since Firefox 155 (2026-09-01). ESR lines 115 and 153 are listed in the Firefox profile; Tor Browser 15.0.26 is on ESR 140. Confirm the supported ESR lines at https://whattrainisitnow.com/ before relying on them.

webkit.label: Safari 27 (2026-09-14)
webkit.note: WebKit security fixes ship with OS releases, so there is no separate major-version gap rule.
